During the year, the company approved a scheme of capital reduction from Rs. 10,73,22,720 (1,07,32,272 equity shares of Rs. 10 each) to Rs. 1,07,32,270 (10,73,227 equity shares of Rs. 10 each) by cancelling 90% of the total issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital. The order from the Hon'ble NCLT, Ahmedabad was received on June 23, 2025.

The company issued, approved and allotted 40,00,000 Convertible Equity Warrants @ Rs.10.50 per share to non-promoters in the EGM held on November 12, 2025. In-principal approval received from BSE on December 30, 2025 and 25% of the total warrant application money has been received.
The Issued, Subscribed and Paid-up Equity Share Capital as on March 31, 2026 was Rs.1,07,32,270.
18 Board Meetings were convened and held during the year 2025-26.
The 46th AGM for FY 2024-25 was held on 30/08/2025 through Video Conferencing. One EGM was held on November 12, 2025 for issue of Convertible Equity Warrants.
Independent Directors Meeting was held on March 14, 2026.
The Company is in the early stage of business revival following the capital reduction and is in the process of scaling up its business activities.

Company converted 20,00,000 warrants out of 40,00,000 convertible equity warrants into shares on April 06, 2026; received Listing Approval from BSE on May 20, 2026; post-issue paid-up capital became 30,73,227 shares of Rs.10 each aggregating Rs. 3,07,32,270.

outlook.statement: The benefits of the fund raise in terms of revenue generation and profitability are expected to be reflected in the forthcoming quarters.

The outlook for the Company remains positive. During the financial year, the Company secured a significant purchase order valued at approximately ₹5 Crore for execution during the financial year 2026-27. This order is expected to strengthen the Company's operational activities and contribute positively to its revenue generation. The management remains optimistic about the Company's growth prospects and will continue to explore suitable business opportunities while maintaining financial discipline.

borrowings.note: The Company has not borrowed loan from any Banks or Financial Institutions during the year under review.
Loan taken from Holding company is unsecured and interest free in nature. This Loan is repayable on demand.

litigation: The Company has received approval from the Hon'ble Bench of NCLT, Ahmedabad for Scheme of Capital reduction on 23/06/2025 which was further confirmed and registered by the BSE on 15/09/2025.
No significant and material order passed by regulators or courts or tribunals impacting going concern status and company's operations in future during the year under review.
No proceedings filed by or against the Company under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 pending before NCLT or other Courts (except previous years already disclosed).
Company has disclosed the impact of pending litigations on its financial position as at 31st March 2026 in the standalone financial statements

risks: Commodity Price Risks: The Company is exposed to the risk of price fluctuation of raw material as well as finished goods.
Regulatory Risks: The company is exposed to risks attached to various statutes and regulations including the Companies Act.
Human Resources Risks: Retaining the existing talent pool and attracting new talent are major risks.
Strategic Risks: Emerging businesses, capital expenditure for capacity expansion, etc., are normal strategic risk faced by the company.
Supply chain disruptions arising from climatic or market conditions
Working capital requirements due to business expansion
